top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Access to Children's Records - During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §746.601(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated during theinvestigation and found to be in violation. A child who is now attending the center did not have a records file on site.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training records were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.
